name: Northern Fund call for proposals (Pacific Salmon Treaty)
summary: Two-stage call from the Northern Fund Committee for projects in the Northern Boundary and Transboundary areas that improve information for resource management, restore marine and freshwater salmon habitat, or enhance wild stocks with low-technology techniques.

eligibility.rule: Project is consistent with and necessary for implementing the Pacific Salmon Treaty
Project provides benefits within the Northern Fund's geographic area
Proponent is eligible to do business in the project's jurisdiction
No overdue reports on this project or past Northern Fund projects at the stage 1 deadline

calls.label: 2027 funding cycle

status.quote: The deadline for concept submissions closed on August 27, 2026.

deadline.quote: The deadline for concept submissions closed on August 27, 2026.

calls.note: Applicants invited after the concept stage submit a detailed proposal by 25 November 2026.

status.quote: Applications for 2028 will open in June 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Applications are welcome from private, non-profit, and public sector organizations.

access.quote: The Pacific Salmon Commission's Northern Fund Committee (NFC) has issued its 2027 Call for Proposals

window.quote: The deadline for concept submissions closed on August 27, 2026. Applications for 2028 will open in June 2027.

geography.quote: The NFC is seeking potential projects for the Northern Boundary and Transboundary areas

effort.quote: Project Concepts must be submitted online through the grantee portal submission form and received by 11:59 p.m. (Pacific Time) on Thursday, August 27, 2026.
The deadline to submit a detailed proposal is 11:59 p.m. PCT on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.

eligibility.quote: projects which are consistent with, and necessary for, the implementation of the Pacific Salmon Treaty (PST).
Projects that provide benefits within this geographic area are eligible for consideration for funding by the NFC subject to the purpose, principals and procedures set forth herein.

after_award.quote: If a project is approved for funding, a technical report and financial statement must be submitted upon project completion.
